name: bld3_rank_involution_defect
statement: (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K) : Matrix.rank (1 + A) + Matrix.rank (1 - A) = Fintype.card ι + Matrix.rank (1 - A * A)
closed: ∀ (K : Type*) [Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type*) [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K), Matrix.rank (1 + A) + Matrix.rank (1 - A) = Fintype.card ι + Matrix.rank (1 - A * A)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.bld2_rank_add_rank_one_sub and Mathlib2.bld2_involution_iff_rank_add_rank: apply the idempotent-defect identity to B = (1/2) • (1 + A): 1 - B = (1/2) • (1 - A) and B - B * B = (1/4) • (1 - A * A), and nonzero scalars do not change rank; this refines the involution criterion.
type: ∀ (K : Type u_1) [inst : Field K] [CharZero K] (ι : Type u_2) [inst_2 : Fintype ι] [inst_3 : DecidableEq ι] (A : Matrix ι ι K), (1 + A).rank + (1 - A).rank = Fintype.card ι + (1 - A * A).rank
